name: Unite Group PLC
summary: Unite Group PLC is the UK's largest owner, manager and developer of purpose-built student accommodation (PBSA) serving the country's world-leading higher education sector. Its property portfolio includes the Unite Students and Hello Student brands. Together, the Group provides homes for 72,000 students across 207 properties in 29 leading university towns and cities. The firm currently partners with over 60 universities across the UK. The people are driven by a shared purpose, (to provide a home for success for the students who live with us).
